loops.description: Unattended development loop: sync main -> plan and complete the oldest issue -> verify -> create and approve a PR -> auto-merge -> close the issue

tasks.name: Preflight: require a clean tree and sync main
commandArgs: -c
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Recovery: dirty tree, reset and return to main
commandArgs: -c
git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Select and reserve the oldest code:pick issue
commandArgs: -c

number=$(gh issue list --label "code:pick" --state open --limit 1000 --json number --jq "sort_by(.number) | .[0].number"); test -n "$number" || exit 75; body=$(gh issue view "$number" --json number,title,body --jq "{number,title,body}"); gh issue edit "$number" --add-label code:doing --remove-label code:pick >/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "$body"

tasks.name: Implement: complete the issue directly with OpenCode
commandArgs: run

First, load all skills available for your current agent. Then take complete ownership of this GitHub issue. First inspect the current repository state and determine whether the work is untouched, partially implemented, or already present but incomplete. If work is missing, do it. If work already exists, identify and complete all remaining work rather than starting over. Plan the remaining work internally before coding, then implement it. Verify that the issue is actually complete before finishing: run the relevant checks, inspect the resulting behavior, and fix any failures. Do not stop after planning, do not stop after a summary, and do not claim completion without verification. Preserve correct existing work and make the smallest correct change. Work on a feature branch. Never explore or read files outside the current repository root. Do not push or perform any GitHub actions. Never ask for confirmation. Generate visual evidence where the change affects the UI. Issue title: {{title}} Issue body: {{body}} Issue id: {{number}}

tasks.name: Verify: lint, typecheck, tests, and build
commandArgs: -c
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

tasks.name: Stage and commit all changes
commandArgs: -c
git add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve #{{number}} {{title}}" || true

tasks.name: Create PR and squash merge (auto-admin)
commandArgs: -c

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && git push -u origin "$BRANCH" >/dev/null && PR_URL=$(gh pr create --title "Resolve #{{number}}: {{title}}" --body "Closes #{{number}}" --label code:done) && gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --squash --delete-branch --admin && printf '{"prUrl":"%s"}\n' "$PR_URL"

tasks.name: Complete: mark the issue done, close it, and return to main
commandArgs: -c
gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:done --remove-label code:doing --remove-label code:review && gh issue close {{number}} && git checkout -- . && git clean -fd && git switch main

tasks.name: Recovery: reset implementation and return the issue to code:pick
commandArgs: -c
git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch main && gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:pick --remove-label code:doing

tasks.name: Recovery: retry merge with admin, then leave for review
commandArgs: -c

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ]; then   PR_URL=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json url --jq ".[0].url" 2>/dev/null);   if [ -n "$PR_URL" ]; then     gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --squash --delete-branch --admin && exit 0;   fi; fi; gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:review --remove-label code:doing && git checkout -- . && git clean -fd && git switch main

tasks.name: Idle: no code:pick issues are available
commandArgs: Nothing to do, no issues with code:pick label
